messages:
olivia: dropping a concise RN + internal announce draft for v2.4-quant-candidate. need one-line copycheck, a pin owner, and rollback watcher. plan below.

olivia: RN draft:
• What: v2.4-quant-candidate — updated quant kernels to reduce memory vs v2.3 and ~20% token/sec uplift on mid-long prompts
• Why: lower unit cost on embeddings-heavy workloads and fewer streaming stalls
• Fixes: reduces KV cache miss penalty; mitigates rare soft-fail on 64k contexts
• Compatibility: Dedicated customers will automatically fall back to v2.3.x when GPU pool is constrained

olivia: rollout sketch: staged canary 1% -> 10% after 12m -> 40% after 40m -> 100% after 90m. rollback gates: error rate >2.5x baseline for 3m OR p95 latency jump >550ms for 10m. enable debug logs for canary first 20m and keep metric sampling at 1s for the canary cohort.

matt: timeline ok. i can own the model pin + run. suggested model id: model-redwood/v2.4-qc1 pinned to inference-v2.4 stack.
jordan: i'll take the rollback watch and final GO/NO-GO. I'll wire a short heartbeat and reduce alert thresholds for the first 30m. ping me on 10% promote.

kevin: docs/copy nit — change "candidate" -> "preview" in end-user-facing wording. internal blurb suggestion: "Heads up: v2.4 preview rolling at 22:00 UTC — improves throughput and reduces warmup stalls. Ops monitoring; updates to follow."

olivia: updated. internal one-liner saved. adding customer-facing note: "Preview rollout to reduce token cost; brief warmup expected."

matt: deploy-bot params i will schedule for 2025-07-02T22:00:00Z. job id will be generated at schedule. planned commands below.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by @matt. job id: db-1965004321. commands:
```
deploy-bot run db-1965004321 --stage canary --percent 1 --wait 720 --debug-logs true
deploy-bot promote db-1965004321 --percent 10 --wait 1680 --dns-hold 300
deploy-bot promote db-1965004321 --percent 40 --wait 3000 --fallback-delay 600
deploy-bot promote db-1965004321 --percent 100
deploy-bot rollback db-1965004321 --reason "rollback gate triggered"
```

jordan: please add --sample-rate 1s for canary metrics (thanks for calling that out). i'll also prepare the rollback playbook and short incident template for customer ops.

kevin: i'll post internal snippet to #internal-release at T-10 and ping #customer-ops. also prepping the release notes page to include the quant profile changes and the fallback behavior note.

matt: set job to queued. i'll run a dry-run of the deploy-bot commands in staging at T-30 to validate parameters.

olivia: final checklist: RN draft saved, internal blurb ready, model pin set to model-redwood/v2.4-qc1, deploy job scheduled and queued, rollback watch assigned to jordan, DNS hold and fallback-delay flags set. go/no-go check at 21:40 UTC.

matt: will confirm at 21:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: job db-1965004321 moved to queued state by @matt.
